name: Suou Issei
source:
The eldest out of five siblings.
A kind and serious man with a strong sense of responsibility.
A family oriented type who is good at looking after people and is skilled at a variety of household chores.
He's used to treating other people but is not so good at treating himself.
He's skilled at his job in public relations.
His flower is the Cosmos.
